name: Ren'ai Taishitsu
source:
"From today, I appoint you President!"
Until yesterday, you were only a regular employee. However...
In an unexpected turn of events, you became President!?

"It's not bad to be relied on by a cute girl".
"Don't worry, I'll protect you".

Having these handsome employees support you as a new President, you find your heart stolen.
translation:
“从今天起，我任命你为社长！”

直到昨天，你还只是普通职员。然而……事情突然转折，你成了社长！？

“被可爱女孩依赖也不错。”

“别担心，我会保护你。”

英俊职员们支持着新任社长，你的心也被他们夺走。
